answer_1.quote: We construct a meta-dataset ... includes a wide variety of NLP tasks ... such as Title Generation, Data to Text, Summarization, Question Rewriting, Grammar Error Correction ...
answer_1.outputs: Model‑generated task outputs such as summaries, titles, rewrites, and corrected sentences

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE-L as our automatic evaluation metric in this work.

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to crowdsource feedback on the quality of the generated responses of models ... we ask crowdworkers to indicate if they prefer the predicted answer by the model or the ground truth outputs for each instance.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdworkers indicate whether they prefer the model output, the ground‑truth output, or a tie.
